title: Break and Continue
description: Stop a loop early with break, or skip one turn with continue.

content.value: Sometimes you want to stop a loop early, or skip just one turn. Python gives you two keywords for this: `break` and `continue`.
`break` stops the loop right away, even if there were more turns to go. As soon as Python reaches `break`, it leaves the loop completely.
`continue` doesn't stop the loop. It skips the rest of the current turn and jumps straight to the next one.

practice.question: Change the code to print the numbers 1 to 5, but skip the number 3 using continue.

quiz.question: Which keyword stops the whole loop right away?
quiz.explain: `break` leaves the loop completely and stops it. `continue` only skips one turn, and `pass` does nothing.

quiz.question: What does 'continue' do inside a loop?
options: Skips the rest of this turn and starts the next one.
quiz.explain: `continue` skips whatever is left in the current turn and jumps to the next one.
